accounts_receivable.missing_policy: None for absent/null/ambiguous values; never infer zero. Manual review required; zero/missing/full-market audit incomplete.

cash.missing_policy: None when absent; bank monetary funds remain visible but are not used for ROIC without verified interest debt.

contract_assets.missing_policy: None for absent/null/ambiguous values; never infer zero. Manual review required; zero/missing/full-market audit incomplete.

deducted_net_income.missing_policy: None; never substitute reported net income.

ebit.missing_policy: Discovery value is None: vendor EBIT/share has not been reproduced from the disclosed annual-report statements.

income_tax.missing_policy: None when income-tax expense is absent.

interest_debt.missing_policy: None only when every component is absent. The due-within-one-year component can overstate interest-bearing debt.

interest_expense.missing_policy: None for absent/null/ambiguous values; never infer zero. Independent finance interest expense only; INTEREST_EXPENSE (financial-subsidiary cost) and net FINANCE_EXPENSE are not aliases. Manual review required; zero/missing/full-market audit incomplete.

inventory.missing_policy: None for absent/null/ambiguous values; never infer zero. Manual review required; zero/missing/full-market audit incomplete.

net_income.missing_policy: None when parent-attributable profit is absent.

ocf.missing_policy: None when operating net cash flow is absent.

pretax_income.missing_policy: None when total profit is absent.

related_party_funds.missing_policy: None for absent/null/ambiguous values; never infer zero. Manual review required; zero/missing/full-market audit incomplete.

restricted_cash.missing_policy: None for absent/null/ambiguous values; never infer zero. Unmapped: require reviewed restricted monetary funds, not total restricted assets. Missing blocks usable cash and dependent debt/net-cash metrics; independent FCF yield can remain available. Manual review required; zero/missing/full-market audit incomplete.

revenue.missing_policy: None when the reported consolidated line is absent.

shares.missing_policy: None unless the exact field is finite and positive; no total-share alias is accepted.

total_equity_including_minority.missing_policy: None for absent/null/ambiguous values; never infer zero. Gross IC requires this minority-inclusive equity plus verified interest debt; never substitute parent-attributable equity. Manual review required; zero/missing/full-market audit incomplete.
